title: How to Make Friends When You Live Abroad
meta_title: How to Make Friends Living Abroad (What Worked for Me)
subtitle: You are far more likely to run out of social battery than to be lonely. Here is the honest playbook I used to build a real circle of friends in Da Nang.
description: How to make friends when you live abroad, from a nomad in Da Nang: why it is far easier than you fear, the online communities to join first, the hobby meetups like pickleball and board games that actually work, and the apps worth using.

faqs.question: How do you make friends when you move abroad?
faqs.answer: Start online before you even land by joining the local WhatsApp communities and Facebook groups for the city, then pick one hobby that meets on a regular schedule, like a sport or a board game night, and show up to it every single week. The friendships form as a side effect of doing a shared activity with the same people, which is far easier than trying to befriend strangers with no reason to be there.

faqs.question: Is it hard to make friends living abroad?
faqs.answer: Honestly, far less than you fear. The first week or 2 can be quiet, and then in a place like Da Nang it flips completely, because there is so much going on that the real challenge becomes protecting your social battery rather than finding people. Commit to one recurring hobby or one regular place, and a full circle tends to build itself within a couple of months.

faqs.question: How do digital nomads make friends in a new city?
faqs.answer: Mostly through local WhatsApp and Facebook communities, hobby meetups like pickleball, coffee clubs, and board game nights, coworking and studio spaces where the same crowd shows up, and apps built for meeting people, like Reclub for pickleball, Couchsurfing hangouts, and Nomad Table dinners.

faqs.question: Where do you meet other expats in Da Nang?
faqs.answer: The easiest places are the pickleball courts at Union and Bien Dong, a regular morning coffee club, board game nights, a class at the Roots yoga studio, and the Thursday movie nights at Ace Hub. Show up a few times, ask someone for the WhatsApp group link, and you will have a circle within a month.
